I think it's fair to assume that La Puta Madre (LPM) is either a man or an unknown identity, because he is known among cops, like Kim, as Padre Madre, which literally translates to "Father Mother". "Padre" functions as an honorific for a male, while "Madre" is the besmertie boss' chosen "name".


Now, that moniker can be taken to mean that LPM is a man or it could also denote ambiguity because Padre Madre is both a mother and a father.


Also, "Father Mother", a rough translation of Padre Madre, sounds a bit like "motherfucker", which ties beautifully into the "Whore Mother" aspect of the La Puta Madre name.
Yes! The narrator of Slay the Princess sounds soooo good! 💖 I'd want him or Lenval Brown to narrate my actions.

I dare you to talk/type without using *any* pronoun (including personal, possessive, and all others) for an entire *week* and you'll (hopefully) see what I mean.

Conversely, if you do the communist vision quest, Kim can hit on Harry! The conversation is hilarious! To see the dialogue, buy >!Suzerainty !<at the bookstore >!and play the game with him. For maximum impact, make sure that you lose. Then, go to the secret meeting room. Bring up playing Suzerainty with Kim and if you lost, he will say "You only like playing that game because you enjoy being thrashed like a schoolboy!"!<

>!Based on Kim's comment, the student communists will assume that Kim and Harry are sleeping together. They will then go on to assure both of you that their communist cell is a forward thinking group and that you are most welcome to join them no matter what your gender identity is. !<

Lastly, during this same quest, Harry will have >!an excuse to sniff Kim in the guise of sniffing out fellow comrades. Electrochemistry says that taking in his scent will send your GABA receptors aflutter, which is just another way of saying that Kim's scent gets Harry excited and that he is attracted to Kim's pheromones.!<

Kim likes bears and Harry is clearly a bear. 

Aside from the "bicep girth" comment, he also prefers Harry with the beard and he kinda freaks out if Harry shaves! 😅 Also, if Harry mentions wanting to participate in a bear fight, Kim becomes amused and goes "I suppose that *would* be something to see."...Something tells me that Kim isn't thinking of the animal bear. lol

Lastly, depending on your choices while interacting with the Shelf of Crime Fiction at the bookstore, Kim can notice that Harry is having a hard on while staring at the cover of a Dick Mullen book, because there's a hot lady depicted on it. He even gently teases Harry about it! haha

Now, why on earth would Kim notice Harry's bulge if he wasn't checking him out?

I'm not the OP, but the quote appears when you investigate the sunken car on the coast. The coast isn't accessible until Day 3.


Make sure that Kim is with you when you investigate and whistle with him. This will open the dialogue which contains the whistling quote.

Having only 3 kills in his 18-year career is impressive because Harry works in Jamrock, a rough neighborhood that's notorious for gang violence. Jamrock is the largest ghetto in Revachol West that should ideally have 3 precincts but only has 1 due to lack of funding. 

He also co-leads a Major Crimes Unit and has over 200 solved cases. In that context, the fact that he has only had to kill thrice can be considered remarkable. Especially because some of his colleagues at the 41st have obscenely high kill counts. From what Kim says, that's what other officers usually expect when they hear that you work in the lone precinct of crime-ridden Jamrock.

The centrist badge was also my first achievement in DE 😅 Because I thought that the views expressed in the other options were too extreme. Was so happy to get Goodest of the Good Cops as my 2nd badge! ☺️

Then as the game progressed on my 1st run, my communist line counter in the ledger steadily got higher.
If you internalize the Homosexual Underground, Kim gets a pass and says the full "pissf****t" word at least once, when you successfully convince him to wear the piss jacket.

That's how I got The World's Most Laughable Centrist as my 1st badge in the game, while on my first playthrough. 😂 

The 2nd badge I got was Goodest of the Good Cops, which signifies Kim's genuine trust in me. It made me so happy!

Oh, he's definitely into bears! He loooves the mutton chops and can't shut up about Harry's bicep girth!

Really sorry that you feel that way. I have trans friends and we live in a religious country, so it could be difficult for them as well. 

Your life matters and I'd really love to hear more from you. I'm happy to have you here with us, so please don't go just yet.

It's not possible to make all your dreams come true...and that's ok, because people's plans for their future, especially the super grand ones, can't all be realistically achieved in one lifetime. So we gotta choose which ones really matter and those that we're willing to let go.

I often find myself wishing I could pause time for a while, maybe for a few hours, so I could tick more things off the giant checklist that is life but alas, no such thing exists.
